collection.title: Lotus Elise 2001 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Lotus Elise 2001 to 2011 S2 model requires a 26" wiper blade, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment.
